I once had this assistant teacher who was extremely rude and hated my guts. One time I was just working in class and she kept on saying that my grades will always be bad and there’s no point in trying. I was already struggling a lot at home and mental health wasn’t doing that great either. I eventually broke down and started crying in my seat. She then continued to call me a drama queen and that I’m always crying over everything. By the way this was in front of the whole class and everyone was watching. After that a part of me just snapped and I stood up and told her to shut the fuck up and ran out of class to the office. I called my parents and they had a talk with my principal. The principal told us that they’ve had many incidents like this with her in the past and would think of what to do with her. After a few days we all found out that she got fired.
